“Basically, I'm asking for a favor.”

“But you've been pretending you don't care, Nagayama, and your eyes are shining.”
en.html:
Naoya
“But you've been pretending you don't care, Nagayama, and your eyes are shining.”

香奈
「はぁ？　目が？」

「はぁ？　目が？」

Kana
“Huh? My eyes?”

Kana
“Huh? My eyes?”

ja.html:
直哉
「ああ、草薙健一郎が認めた才能と聞いてから、目の色が変わっている」

Naoya
“Yeah. Ever since you heard it was a talent Kenichirou Kusanagi acknowledged, there's been a different look in your eyes.”
en.html:
Naoya
“Yeah. Ever since you heard it was a talent Kenichirou Kusanagi acknowledged, there's been a different look in your eyes.”

「……」

en.text:
Kana
“...”
en.html:
Kana
“...”

観察眼は伊達ではないです」
ja.html:
香奈
「ふぅ、さすが腐っても草薙直哉ですねぇ。

Kana
“Well, fallen or not, you're still Naoya Kusanagi. You really do have a sharp eye.”
en.html:
Kana
“Well, fallen or not, you're still Naoya Kusanagi. You really do have a sharp eye.”

香奈
「天才との立ち会いか……たしかに面白そうですね。
分かりました。明日の夜中ですね」
ja.html:
香奈
「天才との立ち会いか……たしかに面白そうですね。

Kana
“Facing off against a genius... That does sound interesting. All right. Tomorrow night.”
en.html:
Kana
“Facing off against a genius... That does sound interesting. All right. Tomorrow night.”

香奈
「ですが、明日で調整なんて出来るのですか？」
ja.html:
香奈
「ですが、明日で調整なんて出来るのですか？」

en.text:
Kana
“But can you get back into form by tomorrow?”
en.html:
Kana
“But can you get back into form by tomorrow?”

ja.text:
直哉
「調整？」
ja.html:
直哉
「調整？」

en.text:
Naoya
“Back into form?”
en.html:
Naoya
“Back into form?”

香奈
「絵の勘を取り戻す時間ですよ」
ja.html:
香奈
「絵の勘を取り戻す時間ですよ」

en.text:
Kana
“Time to get your feel for painting back.”
en.html:
Kana
“Time to get your feel for painting back.”

直哉

ja.html:
直哉
「そんなものはいらない。お前は、凡人には無限とも思える反復が必要だと言ったよな」

Naoya
“I don't need that. You said ordinary people need seemingly endless repetition, right?”
en.html:
Naoya
“I don't need that. You said ordinary people need seemingly endless repetition, right?”

直哉

直哉
「俺は、その事に関しては、お前に言われる筋合いがないほどやってきた」

Naoya
“I've done so much of that, I'm the last person who needs to hear it from you.”
en.html:
Naoya
“I've done so much of that, I'm the last person who needs to hear it from you.”

直哉
「俺は筆を折っていたが、

ja.html:

“I gave up painting, but I still kept drawing for practice.”

Naoya
“I gave up painting, but I still kept drawing for practice.”

香奈

Kana
“You stopped making works of art, but kept practicing all the same...?”

Naoya
“Yeah. So I don't need to get back into form. I just need to find Sui.”

ja.html:
香奈

Kana

Kana
“Find her...? Is she hard to find?”

直哉

直哉

Naoya
“Yeah. She turns up and disappears when you least expect it.”

Kana

香奈

Kana

Kana

Naoya
